Uzbekistan grid financing is not an Itaipu policy decision or commissioned datacenter MW; AI equipment exports and announced loans do not prove physical energy availability.

No newly comparable global inventory series across oil stocks, staple-food reserves, strategic minerals and medical supplies; FAO food prices and OPEC output requirements are not stock counts.

Prehistory and forager/civilization research already entered Nov 2 corpus/staging. No new dated archaeological primary finding establishes a different economic, social or institutional causal mechanism for a new chapter today.

Nov 3 algorithmic attention/power/social-conflict staging and prior accelerationism corpus cover the active line. New market observations do not independently prove a novel social transformation; avoid duplicating editorial surveillance.
